places.quote: We come, you see, the wind and tide making in our favour, in one of our Yarmouth lugs to Gravesen’.
places.note: Spelled 'Gravesen’' in the text; Mr. Peggotty's party came from here.

places.quote: I shall bring him to Yarmouth, if he will let me, to see your house.
places.note: Also appears in 'Yarmouth boatmen' and 'Yarmouth mail'; Peggotty's home.

places.quote: And if Mr. Steerforth ever comes into Norfolk or Suffolk, Mr. Peggotty,
And if Mr. Steerforth ever comes into Norfolk or Suffolk, Mr. Peggotty,
the ground outside the window was not the playground of Salem House
places.note: Fictional school; the novel places it near Blackheath, but this passage does not say so.
